topic: Police arrested you? Know your rights (11 rights) — grounds in writing (Art 22(1), BNSS s.47; Mihir Rajesh Shah, SC 2025), bail information (s.47(2)), officer's name + arrest memo (s.36), family told (s.48), lawyer (s.38), free legal aid (LSA Act s.12(g)), medical check (s.53), Magistrate in 24 h from actual detention (Art 22(2), s.58; Sujit Das, SC 5 Nov 2026), no compelled self-incrimination (Art 20(3)), women not arrested at night without a Magistrate's prior permission (s.43(5)); one-minute check: save NALSA 15100
audience: Everyday families and young people (primary); law students
